text: Soft trial agreement for the first 2 months only. Clear on pay, expectations, and mutual exit. Not a CLT contract and not deep legal counsel. KPI standards may change with written notice.
Parties
1. What this is
A 2-month testing phase so both sides can see if the seat is a fit.
During these first 2 months, either party may end the engagement for any reason with written notice (email or message is enough).
After the trial, if both want to continue, we align on ongoing pay, levels, and commissions. Nothing here locks long-term salary, levels, or commissions beyond the trial terms below.
2. Pay during the trial (agreed)
Currency: BRL. You invoice as PJ.
Payday: 9th of each month for the prior month’s work, after a simple invoice.
If the trial ends mid-month, Company pays a pro-rata share of that month’s R$4,000 for days worked.
3. What we expect from you (trial)
Plain expectations — not a full job description:
Show up consistently and communicate clearly.
Learn Waiz systems / OS and follow the buying process we teach.
Work assigned accounts carefully; ask before big changes you are unsure about.
Help with creative/ad concepts as asked (learning mode in trial).
Hit toward the KPI standards we set for your accounts (see §4).
Be coachable; flag problems early.
4. KPIs (subject to change)
Company will share KPI targets for accounts you touch (e.g. CPQL / related buying standards).
Those KPI standards are subject to change as we learn the accounts and what “good” looks like. Changes will be communicated in writing.
Missing a KPI in month 1–2 is a coaching signal, not an automatic firing clause — but repeated disregard for process or communication is a reason either side may end the trial under §1.
5. What this trial is not
Not CLT employment.
Not a guarantee of continuing after 2 months.
Not a lock on higher levels (R$5k / R$6k / R$7k) or commissions — those are discussed if we continue after the trial.
Not deep legal terms. If we continue long term, we can add a fuller agreement.
6. Ending the trial
Either party may end during the 2-month testing phase with written notice.
Final pay = days worked (pro-rata) for the current month + any unpaid prior month, on the normal payday cycle (or sooner if Company chooses).
Access to ad accounts and tools ends on the last working day unless otherwise agreed.
7. Signatures
By signing, we agree this soft trial covers initial pay, mutual exit during months 1–2, and expectations as written above.
